Angela knows that Kevin has been unhappy in his construction job, has considered a career change, and has expressed interest in something more creative like design or architecture. In Scenario 3, she also knows Kevin is hesitant, because he explicitly says he is not sure if he is ready. She knows she feels frustrated and worried about his hesitation, and she knows she decides to motivate him by arranging a meeting with a career coach.

Angela does not know, at this point, whether the coaching will actually help, whether Kevin will fully commit, or that he will later make progress and successfully transition careers. Those are later events and should not be attributed to her knowledge in Scenario 3.

Thus, in Scenario 3, Angela’s belief that Kevin is hesitant, combined with her frustration and worry, leads her to intend to motivate Kevin. This matches choice f.

ANSWER: f
